criteria.requirement: Implement bidict.compose.compose(mapping, other, *, missing="error") for two BidirectionalMapping inputs. Compose A->B and B->C into a validated same-concrete-type A->C mapping, preserving left order and both sources. Missing intermediate keys either raise or explicitly select intersection with missing="ignore". Support inverse symmetry, None, empty/frozen/ordered inputs and reject invalid policies/non-bidirectional sources; do not change union or putall semantics.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
